title: glacial-seismic-sensitivity-utac - P133: Early-stage sensitivity tests of glacial-unloading seismicity
description: Does the same seasonal ice/snow unloading trigger more earthquakes over time? Pre-registered 'early-stage' (Fruehstadium) sensitivity tests on national and global earthquake catalogues near shrinking mountain glaciers and ice sheets versus control regions, a criticality/early-warning indicator battery, a simple viscoelastic GIA + rate-and-state lag/detectability model with published mantle viscosities, and a frozen confirmatory test on data from 2026-11-01 onward. Companion of glacial-seismicity-utac (P101). Deliberately has NO UTAC/CREP/AFET bridge. See DISCLAIMER.md. Part of the GenesisAeon ecosystem (P133 - provisional number, domain: climate / glaciology / seismology).
